description: This file defines a nested class ReadOnlyStream within LogExtentBuilder that extends the Stream class, providing read-only stream functionality tied to LogExtentBuilder. It implements methods for reading data, seeking, copying, and enforcing read-only behavior.

classes.name: LogExtentBuilder.ReadOnlyStream
classes.description: A read-only stream class for accessing LogExtentBuilder data with seeking and copying capabilities.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a byte array or span; one is unimplemented (throws NotImplementedException).

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Adjusts the current position based on offset and origin.

methods.name: SetPosition
methods.description: Internal method to set the position with bounds checking.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies data to another stream; uses the builder's async copy method.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous copy to another stream, requires position to be zero.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Throws exception since stream is read-only.

methods.name: WriteByte
methods.description: Throws exception since stream is read-only.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Throws exception since stream is read-only.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Throws exception since stream is read-only.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Throws exception since stream is read-only.

methods.name: SetBuilder
methods.description: Associates a LogExtentBuilder to this stream and initializes its length and position.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream state by clearing builder reference and resetting position and length.

methods.name: ComputeLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the stream based on builder data and variable-length encoding.

methods.name: GetVarIntWidth
methods.description: Computes the width in bytes of a variable-length integer.

methods.name: GetReadOnlyException
methods.description: Returns a NotSupportedException indicating the stream is read-only.
